title: 1. Is Every Lead Reaching Your CRM?
description: Six quick answers about your website forms. You get a map of where leads slip between the form and the first reply, and the fixes in the order to make them.

title: 2. Never Let a Lead Go Cold
description: Five quick answers about how you follow up a new inquiry. You get a ready-to-build workflow, the emails written for you, and the HubSpot steps for your plan.

title: 3. Who Should Own Each New Lead?
description: Six quick answers about your sales team. You get a routing model, your rules drafted in order, and the HubSpot steps to build them on your plan.

title: 4. Which Sales Steps Should Run Themselves?
description: Six quick answers about your deal pipeline. You get the rep hours lost to admin, and a stage-by-stage build sheet for the automations that win them back.

title: 5. How Much Time Is Your Sales Process Wasting?
description: Six quick answers about how new leads move through your business. You get the hours your team loses to hand work, and a ranked list of what to automate first.

title: 6. Is Your Pipeline Ready for a Dashboard?
description: Five quick answers about how you report on your pipeline. You get what the spreadsheet costs, whether your data is ready, and the exact dashboard to build in its place.
